title: hieracium × sterromastix
intro: Hieracium × sterromastix, commonly known as Hawkweed or Devil's Claw, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include pain relief, reducing inflammation, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium × sterromastix include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include harpagoside, which is a key compound responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
